verification.voice_messages: VoiceMessageController owns record button and send pipeline; rim-core gated

verification.e2e_crypto: Signal SDK 14.7.0 and RIM Supabase Relay are connected to protected message paths; secret direct chats require e2e_mode=required and encrypted challenge/ACK readiness; no plaintext fallback for required scopes. Live two-account acceptance remains outstanding.
verification.chat_media_loading: text paints before bounded asynchronous media URL hydration
verification.device_lock: 4-digit PIN, configurable 0/1/5/10/30 minute auto-lock grace, progressive local retry delay; legacy 8-digit PIN remains accepted
verification.e2e_scope_policy: Direct conversations, private groups and private channels eligible; public channels excluded; required mode is trusted-deployment-only and rejects plaintext writes.
verification.zladen_system_bot: Production has Zladen command, moderation, economy, trigger, clan and reminder handlers; migrations 136–141, 170 and 171 are applied, pg_cron runs the reminder dispatcher every minute, and rim-zladen Edge Function is ACTIVE. Iteration 176 adds the group admin command console and trigger forms.
verification.message_search: Scoped plaintext-only conversation search with bounded context jump; server search explicitly refuses E2E/pending/unknown scopes. Local encrypted E2E search remains future work.
verification.chat_startup: Classic bootstrap waits for modular app readiness before authenticated initialization; 20-second visible timeout state prevents an endless initial chat-list placeholder.
verification.browser_bundle: Root index.html loads assets/js/rim-app.bundle.js; pinned Signal SDK is bundled and SQLite worker/WASM are same-origin root assets.
verification.zladen_social_games: Iteration 177: safe group mini-games and neutral social actions; no wagering or E2E execution.
verification.imperial_controls: Iteration 177: superadmin-only searchable channel/group directory, server-enforced media controls, and configurable welcome notifications.
verification.feed_personalization: Iteration 177: topic preferences, muted topics/authors, personalized ranking and feed event telemetry.

iteration_135.bot_runtime: source workspace and isolated-vm runtime prepared; runtime host not deployed
iteration_135.e2e: signed device identity and prekey directory foundation; not production E2E

iteration_136.e2e: Scope schema, encrypted payload columns, per-device group key package table, pending-only RPC, RLS and fail-closed plaintext guards. Protocol SDK and message path are not integrated; E2E is OFF.
iteration_136.zladen: First-party system-bot identity, per-user direct chat, welcome message, /start /help /commands /ping /id, owner-only profile editing UI. Full Iris feature parity not implemented.
iteration_136.deployment: Migrations and rim-zladen Edge Function are local only. Requires RIM_OWNER_USER_ID secret before bot provisioning.

iteration_138.e2e: Pinned OpenE2EE Signal Protocol SDK 14.7.0 and idb dependency; lazy browser IndexedDB client composition with strict post-quantum policy. Relay adapter and RIM send/read integration remain incomplete; readiness remains false.
iteration_138.zladen: Additive profile, chat-rank, permission, command-alias, virtual-ledger, reputation, eight-tier award, notes, bookmarks, reports, polls, reminders, clans, declarative trigger, anti-spam and metadata-only statistics schema; initial commands include profile, balance, transfer, reputation, notes, report, rank, awards and anti-spam.
iteration_138.deployment: Migrations 136–141 and the rim-zladen Edge Function are active in production. The command/economy/triggers platform is live; remaining parity work is feature coverage and UI polish.

iteration_142.e2e: Application-owned Supabase Signal Protocol relay adapter and Edge Function; authenticated primary-device bootstrap; canonical composite identity provisioning/rotation; EC+ML-KEM prekey publication and atomic consumption; ciphertext-only mailbox; idempotent delivery; Realtime wakeups and recovery pull; account-isolated encrypted OPFS/IndexedDB store; AES-256-GCM local content cache; real SDK post-quantum two-account round-trip passes against test-only in-memory relay. RIM chat composer/repository integration, Supabase staging execution, real browser two-account test and linked-device transfer remain incomplete. protocolReady remains false.
iteration_142.zladen: No speculative new game or economy features in this iteration. Next work should map verified Iris functions to existing RIM modules before implementation.
iteration_142.deployment: Iteration 142 SQL migration and rim-e2e-relay Edge Function are local only; no production database or deployment changed.

iteration_163.chat_startup: Fixed session-restore/module-load race; modular chat loader and conversation-open entrypoints are ready before authenticated bootstrap.
iteration_163.message_search: Added scoped plaintext message search with a bounded timeline context jump; E2E/pending/unknown scopes fail closed.
iteration_163.e2e: Bundled pinned SDK 14.7.0 into the GitHub Pages root and included the SQLite worker/WASM. protocolReady remains false; two-account live test and secure multi-device linking remain incomplete.
iteration_163.zladen: Found production gap: source migrations 136–141 and rim-zladen Edge Function were not deployed. Updated source Edge Function with fail-closed unique-superadmin owner resolution; no Zladen schema or identity was deployed/provisioned.

iteration_176.zladen: Group admin command console with server-validated command shortcuts, safe trigger creation/deletion forms, join greetings, and fail-closed behavior for E2E required/pending groups. Existing production commands cover moderation, rank/permissions, virtual points, shop/inventory/market, polls, reminders and clans.
iteration_176.feed: Private feed-media bucket with per-post visibility-aware Storage RLS, image/video/audio/PDF/text uploads, signed URLs, saved-post collection tab, existing following/recommended feeds, likes and comments.
iteration_176.database: Production pg_cron enabled; reminder scheduler migration 171 applied; feed-media storage migration applied; migration files aligned to actual Supabase history.
iteration_176.e2e: No Signal Protocol, relay, device-key, encryption, or E2E schema changes. Bot command console refuses required and pending E2E groups.
iteration_176.known_limits: No real-device Android smoke test yet; no real-account Zladen group acceptance test yet. Feed media limited to 25 MB and allowlisted MIME types.

iteration_177.zladen: Added group mini-games (/games, /roll, /random, /choose, /yesno, /percent, /who, /pair, /say), neutral social actions, and activity stats; no wagers; fail closed in E2E pending/required.
iteration_177.feed: Multiple inline attachments, paste/drop, bold/italic, post topics, explicit interest preferences, personalized ranking and muted topics/authors.
iteration_177.imperial: Server-backed searchable channel/group directory, collapsible cards, per-space image/video controls enforced by Storage RLS, welcome notifications and admin system notices.
iteration_177.sdk: Restored exact SDK 14.7.0 from verified offline bootstrap artifact; npm dependencies restored; root lockfile unchanged.
iteration_177.e2e: Signal Protocol and E2E SQL unchanged; relay integration tests pass.

iteration_178.zladen: Configurable link and administrator-defined word/phrase filters with server-side pre-insert enforcement, metadata-only audit and E2E scope exclusion.
iteration_178.feed: Public channel posts can be cross-posted into the home feed manually or during publish; source IDs are unique and server-validated. Home feed text/topics autosave per account.
iteration_178.privacy: Private and E2E channels are excluded from cross-posting.
iteration_178.e2e: No E2E implementation, relay, key, SDK or message-path changes in this iteration.

iteration_182.zladen: Fixed Auth provisioning password generation to respect Supabase Auth 72-character maximum; added diagnostic logging for Auth Admin creation failures.
iteration_182.identity: Clarified member_number as a historical registration serial, not the live account count.
iteration_182.e2e: Signal SDK 14.7.0, relay, key material, ciphertext storage and E2E policy are intentionally unchanged.
